FIELDS.NAME: First Community Bank
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Compliance Officer, First Community Bank, (555) 123-4567, john.smith@firstcommunitybank.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: First Community Bank is a community-focused financial institution dedicated to providing a range of banking services to individuals, small businesses, and local organizations. Our core operations include offering savings and checking accounts, personal and commercial loans, mortgage services, and investments. We pride ourselves on maintaining a rigorous compliance program to adhere to all regulatory requirements and ensure the security of our customers' data. Our experienced team is committed to fostering strong relationships within the community, emphasizing financial literacy, and supporting local initiatives. At First Community Bank, we have implemented secure vaults and restricted access to sensitive areas, safeguarding our clients' assets. Our commitment to providing reliable, professional, and personalized banking services helps us ensure a stable and positive experience for our customers.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Community financial consulting and advisory services.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Date: 03/15/2023; Cause: Minor theft of cash from the vault; Amount: $1,200.00; Status: Resolved with no further claims.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Secure Class A vault with 24/7 electronic monitoring and restricted access, compliant with all relevant safety standards.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: 24-hour surveillance system and on-site security personnel for enhanced safety measures.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – First Community Bank has not been involved in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials in any of its operations. The bank focuses solely on providing banking services and operates under strict compliance with regulatory requirements.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – First Community Bank does not sponsor athletic teams as part of its community-focused banking operations. The institution prioritizes providing financial services and supporting local initiatives related to financial literacy.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. Our compliance officer, John Smith, is responsible for checking all certificates.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – First Community Bank has not had any applicants indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property. The institution maintains a strong compliance program to mitigate risks.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – First Community Bank has not had any policy or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years. The institution maintains a strong compliance program and favorable relationships with its previous carriers.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – First Community Bank does not lease employees to or from other employers as part of its operations. The bank maintains its workforce internally to ensure consistent service and compliance with regulatory requirements.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – First Community Bank does not currently have Workers Compensation insurance as it operates under a compliance program that addresses employee safety and risk management internally. However, it ensures that it meets all regulatory requirements and maintains a commitment to employee well-being.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – First Community Bank owns and operates a community financial consulting and advisory service in addition to its banking operations. This additional business complements its core mission of serving local residents and organizations.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – First Community Bank does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. The only active policy is the one currently set to renew.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – First Community Bank is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. The institution focuses exclusively on providing banking services and operates under a strict compliance program.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – First Community Bank does not rent or loan equipment to others, as its operations are focused solely on providing banking services to individuals and businesses. This aligns with our commitment to regulatory compliance and risk management.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – First Community Bank has not experienced any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years, maintaining a stable financial profile.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – First Community Bank does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as it focuses solely on providing banking services and operates under strict regulatory compliance.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – First Community Bank does not have any catastrophe exposure as it solely operates as a financial institution, providing banking services without involvement in high-risk activities that could lead to catastrophic losses.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – First Community Bank has not experienced any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The institution maintains a strong commitment to compliance and employee training to mitigate such risks.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – First Community Bank has no uncorrected fire code violations. The institution ensures compliance with fire safety regulations and maintains all necessary certifications for its operations.
